description: Read recent webhook deliveries for one endpoint, newest first: event type, attempt count, last HTTP status and next retry time. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

limit.description: Maximum recent webhook deliveries to return (1 to 100), newest first. Defaults to 20.

name: webhooks_events
title: Read webhook deliveries
